Solara — (9.8) SOLSTICE

COUNCIL COUNSEL

"Council counsel"

[Verse 1]

The council arrived at Level one

Fold one

Just the right time

(everyone went still)

(the kind of still that means do not touch anything)

(do not say the wrong thing)

(do not say anything)

Young Yeshaw was already there

He was eating soup

(the pepper made it better)

[Pre-Chorus]

The crew looked at the council

The council looked at the crew

Nobody moved

Then Cassie said it first

[Spoken]

[Cassie:] We are from a different time

[Chaos:] Also we are famous where we come from

[Cassie:] Chaos

[Chaos:] I am just providing context

[Chorus]

Council counsel

Do not mess up history

Do not touch anything

Do not name anything that has not happened yet

We are visitors

We are very careful visitors

(Some of us)

(Mostly)

[Verse 2]

Asala saw her first

Across the room

Her young self

At the far end of the council table

(she went very still)

(then she went somewhere else entirely)

[Spoken]

[Persy:] Where is Asala going

[Rion:] She is not coming back

[Persy:] Is she alright

[Rion:] She is handling it

(Persy did not ask how)

(he already knew)

The young Asala had not looked up

She was listening to the council

She was already thinking

(she had always been thinking)

[Pre-Chorus 2]

The council counted them

The crew counted the council

Nobody’s numbers agreed

This was a problem for later

(the soup was here now)

[Chorus 2]

Council counsel

Do not mess up history

Do not touch anything

Do not name anything that has not happened yet

We are visitors

We are very careful visitors

(Some of us)

[Bridge]

The room happened all at once

[Crotus:] Would you like some

(the soup moved around the table)

(young Yeshaw had a second bowl)

(the pepper made it better again)

[Chaos:] Before we get into everything

[Cassie:] No!

[Chaos:] The bounty

[Cassie:] No!

[Chaos:] I am just asking if they have heard of

[Cassie:] No!

Cygnus danced - he is Steve here

(a small one)

(to mark the moment)

Ruin knocked over something structural

Mayhem caught it

In the catching knocked over something else

Havoc found a different ceiling

[Cassie:] Brome

[Brome:] ready

[Cassie:] do not

[Brome:] (ready)

[Brome:] (the chair did not survive)

Persy said: I am excellent at this

Rion said: I am better at this

[Cassie:] You are both sitting down

[Persy:] excellently

[Rion:] better

Madela had found a corner

Madela had found a different corner

Madela was cleaning

(she had already cleaned the first corner)

(she was ahead of the room)

[Pre-Chorus 3]

The council watched all of this

They did not understand all of this

They understood enough

[Final Chorus - key lift]

Council counsel

They have seen the fragment

They recognize the fragment

They need three days to fix it

Three days and we go home

Three days and we are back where we belong

(do not mess up history for three more days)

[Outro]

[Asala:] (from somewhere else entirely) How long

[Cassie:] Three days

[Asala:] (good)

The council began the work

The room settled

(young Yeshaw had a third bowl)

(he was really enjoying the soup)

(the pepper made it better)

(the pepper always made it better)

Three days

They just had to not break history

For three more days

(they looked at Ruin)

(at Havoc)

(at Brome)

(at Chaos)

(maybe two days)

And Cygnus danced - He is Steve here.
